systems.name: Real-Time Crime Center
components: ShotSpotter acoustic sensors (~7 sq mi coverage, 97% accuracy claimed)
Drone feeds (Drone as First Responder program, 60-90 sec response)
Fixed surveillance cameras (22 initial + park expansions)
ALPR streams (22 fixed + 73 mobile in Sheriff patrol cars)
Daktronics 7x12 ft dvLED wall (1.2mm pixel pitch)
Four mobile solar camera trailers (+2 added FY25-26, likely total 6)
systems.operators: Pueblo PD with High Point Networks infrastructure support
sources: City of Pueblo State of the City 2026 (public safety section)
systems.notes: Operating 10am-midnight; hiring for 24/7 operations. Centralizes telemetry in one managed vendor environment.

systems.name: Community Connect
components: Preferred integrators: Arden, High Point Networks, Linx
participation_options: Camera Registry Only (register locations, provide footage on request)
Genetec Cloud Video SaaS (cloud-based, no local equipment)
On-Premise Genetec System (existing systems can integrate)
sources: City of Pueblo Community Connect Program page (accessed 2025-11)
systems.notes: Voluntary registry; participants can opt-out anytime. RTCC staff NOT actively monitoring in real-time; access only for investigations.

systems.name: Flock Safety ALPR
components: Integration with statewide network (1,091 cameras in Colorado)
systems.operators: Pueblo Downtown Association with Pueblo PD access
systems.notes: 30-day cloud retention; motion-activated. Images/data are property of camera owner. No facial recognition capability per vendor.

systems.name: Pueblo County Sheriff Mobile ALPR
components: 73 Automobile License Plate Recognition systems in patrol cars
systems.notes: Part of dash cam setup; compares captures to state and national databases. Sheriff Lucero reported positive impact within one month on stolen vehicles.

systems.name: ShotSpotter / SoundThinking
components: Acoustic sensors on buildings and street lamps
systems.coverage: ~7 square miles (expanded from initial 3 sq mi)

performance.unreported_to_911: 73% of alerts were NOT called in by citizens
performance.lives_saved: 9 gunshot victims received rapid first aid

systems.notes: Alerts within 60 seconds; operates 24/7 without witness reports. Chief Noeller sharing workflows with other agencies.

systems.name: Drone as First Responder Program
systems.notes: Footage integrated into RTCC when deployed. Sheriff also operates S.O.A.R.R. UAV program for life-saving missions and crime scene documentation.

systems.name: Park Surveillance Infrastructure
systems.notes: Enables real-time data transmission to RTCC.

systems.name: Commercial telemetry & vendor data stores
systems.operators: Third-party vendors contracted by Pueblo PD
systems.notes: Private vendors hold primary evidence; subpoena processes and retention policies must be documented.

incidents.title: Crime reduction statistics (2025)
incidents.summary: PPD reports 40% reduction in violent crime, 50% reduction in homicides (9 vs 15 through Aug 2024), drive-by shootings down from 118 to 84.
incidents.status: Chief Noeller credits RTCC technology as 'force multiplier'.

incidents.title: Officer shootings by repeat offenders
incidents.summary: March 2025: 3 officers shot by MS-13 gang member with 14 prior felony arrests. April 2025: 2 officers shot in head by repeat offender. Chief Noeller pushing for criminal justice reform.
incidents.status: Chief stated 'blood of my officers is on steps of capitol' regarding soft-on-crime legislation.

incidents.title: IA / POST escalation flow
incidents.summary: Complaints start with Pueblo PD Internal Affairs; criminal issues escalate to DA/POST; systemic issues via AG Pattern & Practice form.
incidents.status: Need standardized evidence packets and tracking.

incidents.title: Flock-ICE Scandal: 1,400+ Immigration Searches via Colorado ALPR Network
incidents.summary: Out-of-state agencies and Border Patrol ran 1,400+ searches with ICE/immigration justifications via Denver's Flock national lookup feature. 690 searches post-Trump inauguration. Loveland PD admitted sharing portal with ICE federal agent. Pueblo's Downtown Association Flock cameras potentially accessible via national network.
incidents.status: ACTION: CORA Pueblo PD to confirm if national lookup enabled; demand City Council resolution prohibiting ICE data sharing.

incidents.title: EFF Exposes Flock Surveillance of Protesters Nationwide
incidents.summary: EFF analyzed 12+ million Flock searches. 50+ agencies ran hundreds of protest-related searches. Tulsa PD: 38 protest searches. Delaware State Police: 9 searches targeting animal-rights activists. Border Patrol accessed during trial period.
incidents.status: ACTION: CORA audit logs for Pueblo ALPR searches by external agencies; demand warrant requirement.

incidents.title: Pueblo Police Racial Disparities in Deadly Force (2013-2023)
incidents.summary: Police Scorecard data shows Black persons 2.8x more likely and Latinx persons 2x more likely to be killed by Pueblo police than white persons. 57% of arrests for low-level, non-violent offenses. More racial disparities than 54% of departments evaluated.
incidents.status: ACTION: Demand demographic impact analysis before surveillance expansions; push for civilian oversight commission.

incidents.title: Colorado ALPR Warrant Legislation Pending
incidents.summary: Sen. Amabile's proposed law would require warrant based on probable cause for police to share ALPR data with other agencies, parallel to GPS/cellphone tracking requirements.
incidents.status: ACTION: Organize community testimony supporting bill; coordinate with ACLU-CO.

civil_liberties_concerns.issue: Flock ALPR network used to surveil protesters
civil_liberties_concerns.details: EFF November 2025 report highlighted police use of Flock Safety network for surveillance beyond criminal investigations, including tracking protesters and activists.
No identified independent review board or civilian oversight of RTCC operations. Limited public documentation of data retention policies and interagency sharing.
Voluntary program lacks published retention limits or warrant requirements for police access to private camera feeds.
